harnessNotes: After browser Back, one semantic button click timed out at CDP mouse dispatch; native view remained the form and provider log still contained only the single success. No duplicate submission was attempted before checking effects.

A later locator Return did not submit; provider stayed at two requests, all validity flags were true and submit enabled. Native Tab focused the submit button; native Return completed one retry. No duplicate provider calls. Pointer retry after Back remains unclaimed.

Initial two per-Back comparisons incorrectly compared privacy-redacted Email value with literal text. Kept as diagnostic probes; acceptance uses the combined journey, unchanged Email input, and actual captured retry body rather than reading around the redaction.
